proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemMechanics.composite
proposed_widenings.justification: The item combines passive grants, passive triggered punishment, and a charge-based activated ability. The current magic-item surface only allows one family at a time.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls while you wear or hold it. ... A Fiend or an Undead that touches the talisman takes 8d6 Radiant damage ... Pure Rebuke. The talisman has 7 charges.

proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_numeric.attackFilter = spell_attack
proposed_widenings.justification: The passive bonus applies to spell attack rolls specifically, not all attack rolls.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls while you wear or hold it.

proposed_widenings.name: item_triggered_passive_hazard
proposed_widenings.justification: The hostile-touch damage is a passive item effect with touch and turn-end holding triggers, which the current magic-item families cannot express.
proposed_widenings.evidence: A Fiend or an Undead that touches the talisman takes 8d6 Radiant damage and takes the damage again each time it ends its turn holding or carrying the talisman.

proposed_widenings.name: save_gate.conditional_target_disadvantage
proposed_widenings.justification: Pure Rebuke changes the save only for targets of certain creature types while remaining otherwise targetable by any creature.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If the target is a Fiend or an Undead, it has Disadvantage on the save.

proposed_widenings.name: destroy_creature
proposed_widenings.justification: The failure branch destroys the target outright instead of dealing damage or applying a condition.
proposed_widenings.evidence: On a failed save, the target falls into the fissure and is destroyed, leaving no remains.

notes: Did not author Dhall/JSON/trace because any current encoding would be misleading. The item also has an unmodeled attunement-class restriction: Cleric or Paladin only.
